vehicles.title: BMW M4 Competition xDrive
vehicles.excerpt: M4 Competition with xDrive all-wheel drive, 375 kW and 18,400 km. A fast, usable coupé for every season.
description: This M4 Competition combines the 3.0-litre twin-turbo straight-six with xDrive all-wheel drive, which makes its 375 kW easy to use in Belgian weather. The eight-speed automatic and adaptive M suspension let it switch between relaxed motorway cruising and a sharp, precise drive on a good road.

It is finished in Isle of Man Green with a black Merino leather interior and M sport seats. Equipment includes the head-up display, Harman Kardon audio, adaptive cruise control and the M sport exhaust.
The car has covered 18,400 km since its first registration in March 2024. It is offered with Car-Pass and a 24-month dealer warranty, and VAT is deductible for business buyers.

vehicles.title: BMW 330e Touring
vehicles.excerpt: Plug-in hybrid 3 Series Touring with M Sport trim, up to 56 km electric range (WLTP) and a practical estate body.
description: The 330e Touring suits drivers who want low running costs on daily commutes without giving up range for longer trips. Short journeys can be covered on electricity, while the 2.0-litre petrol engine takes over for motorway distances.
M Sport trim adds sport seats and sharper styling. The car also has adaptive cruise control, navigation, an electric tailgate and a tow bar, which makes it a capable family and company estate.
First registered in May 2023 with 54,800 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.

vehicles.title: BMW i4 M50
vehicles.excerpt: Dual-motor i4 M50 with 400 kW, 497 km WLTP range and a practical liftback body.
description: The i4 M50 is BMW’s electric Gran Coupé with two motors and all-wheel drive. Its 400 kW deliver strong performance, while a WLTP range of 497 km covers most weekly driving on a single charge.

A heat pump helps preserve range in winter, and DC fast charging keeps longer trips practical. Inside are Vernasca leather sport seats, a head-up display and Harman Kardon audio. The liftback tailgate opens to a usable boot.
First registered in February 2024 with 21,300 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 24-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.

vehicles.title: Mercedes-Benz GLE 450 4MATIC
vehicles.excerpt: Spacious GLE 450 4MATIC with a smooth six-cylinder, air suspension and a light beige leather interior.
description: The GLE 450 4MATIC pairs a 3.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine and mild-hybrid assistance with the nine-speed automatic and permanent all-wheel drive. It is a quiet, comfortable SUV for long distances and towing.

AMG Line exterior styling, a panoramic roof, air suspension and Burmester audio are fitted, together with a 360° camera and an electric tailgate. The Macchiato Beige leather interior gives the cabin a light, calm feel.
First registered in April 2022 with 67,200 km. Sold under the margin scheme with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty.

vehicles.title: Mercedes-Benz C300e Estate
vehicles.excerpt: Former demonstrator C 300 e Estate with 9,400 km and more than 100 km of electric range (WLTP).
description: This C 300 e Estate was used as a demonstration vehicle and has covered 9,400 km since June 2025. Its 25.4 kWh battery gives a WLTP electric range of 108 km, so many owners can do most daily driving without using petrol.
Unlike most plug-in hybrids, it also supports DC fast charging. AMG Line trim, adaptive cruise control, an electric tailgate and wireless charging are fitted.
Supplied with Car-Pass and a 24-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible, which makes it a strong choice as a company car.

vehicles.title: Mercedes-Benz A250e
vehicles.excerpt: Compact plug-in hybrid A-Class with AMG Line trim and 68 km electric range (WLTP).
description: The A 250 e combines a compact hatchback body with a plug-in hybrid drivetrain and 68 km of WLTP electric range, which covers most urban driving in and around Brussels.
AMG Line trim, the widescreen digital cockpit, navigation and adaptive cruise control are fitted. The car was first registered in September 2022 and has covered 41,900 km.
This vehicle has been sold. Contact us if you are looking for a similar compact plug-in hybrid.

vehicles.title: Audi RS6 Avant
vehicles.excerpt: RS 6 Avant with the 4.0 TFSI V8, 441 kW and a full family-estate interior. Nardo Grey with black Valcona leather.
description: The RS 6 Avant combines a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with a large, practical estate body. With 441 kW and quattro all-wheel drive it is very quick, yet the adaptive air suspension keeps it comfortable on long journeys.
This car is finished in Nardo Grey with black Valcona leather sport seats. Matrix LED headlights, Bang & Olufsen audio, a panoramic roof, a 360° camera and the RS sport exhaust are fitted.
First registered in January 2023 with 38,700 km. Sold under the margin scheme with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty.

vehicles.title: Audi Q5 55 TFSI e
vehicles.excerpt: Q5 55 TFSI e quattro S line: plug-in hybrid SUV with 270 kW, quattro all-wheel drive and a tow bar.
description: The Q5 55 TFSI e is the most powerful plug-in hybrid in the Q5 range. Its 270 kW system output and quattro all-wheel drive give confident performance, and 62 km of WLTP electric range covers shorter trips.
S line trim adds sport seats in leather and Alcantara. Matrix LED headlights, adaptive cruise control, an electric tailgate and a tow bar are fitted.
First registered in March 2023 with 46,300 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.

vehicles.title: Audi e-tron GT quattro
vehicles.excerpt: Electric four-door grand tourer with 350 kW, 800-volt fast charging and 472 km WLTP range.
description: The e-tron GT quattro is a low, wide four-door grand tourer with two electric motors and quattro all-wheel drive. Its 800-volt architecture allows very fast DC charging, and the WLTP range is 472 km.
This example is finished in Tactical Green with a black leather interior, panoramic glass roof, Bang & Olufsen audio and Matrix LED headlights. A heat pump is fitted for better winter efficiency.
First registered in July 2023 with 24,800 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 24-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.

vehicles.title: Porsche 911 Carrera
vehicles.excerpt: 992-generation 911 Carrera in GT Silver with PDK, sport exhaust and Burmester audio.
description: The 992-generation 911 Carrera uses a 3.0-litre twin-turbo flat-six with 283 kW and the eight-speed PDK gearbox. It is a precise sports car that remains comfortable enough for regular use.
This car is finished in GT Silver with a black leather interior and sport seats. PASM adaptive damping, the sport exhaust system, Burmester audio and adaptive cruise control are fitted.
First registered in May 2022 with 32,100 km. Sold under the margin scheme with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty.

vehicles.title: Porsche Macan T
vehicles.excerpt: Macan T with sport-tuned chassis, PDK and 17,600 km. A compact Porsche SUV focused on handling.
description: The Macan T uses the 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine with 195 kW and a seven-speed PDK gearbox. Porsche tuned its chassis for sharper handling than the standard Macan, with PASM adaptive damping fitted as standard.
Finished in Gentian Blue with black leather and Sport-Tex seat centres. The car has the sport exhaust, an electric tailgate, navigation and adaptive cruise control.
First registered in April 2024 with 17,600 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 24-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.

vehicles.title: Range Rover Sport P440e
vehicles.excerpt: Range Rover Sport plug-in hybrid with 117 km electric range (WLTP), air suspension and Meridian audio.
description: The P440e combines a 3.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor and a 38.2 kWh battery. With a WLTP electric range of 117 km, many daily journeys can be done without using the engine, while the full system output is available for towing and long trips.
Dynamic SE trim brings Windsor leather seats with heating and ventilation, Matrix LED headlights, a head-up display, Meridian audio and a panoramic roof. Air suspension and a tow bar are fitted.
First registered in January 2024 with 22,900 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 24-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.

vehicles.title: Volvo XC60 Recharge
vehicles.excerpt: XC60 T6 Recharge AWD with 81 km electric range (WLTP), Bowers & Wilkins audio and a tow bar.
description: The XC60 T6 Recharge is a plug-in hybrid with all-wheel drive and an 18.8 kWh battery, giving a WLTP electric range of 81 km. It is a calm, comfortable family SUV with a strong focus on safety assistance.

Plus Dark trim includes leather seats, a head-up display, a 360° camera and Bowers & Wilkins audio. Air suspension, a panoramic roof and a tow bar are also fitted. The Google-based infotainment includes Google Maps and supports Apple CarPlay.
First registered in February 2023 with 52,400 km. Sold under the margin scheme with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty.

vehicles.title: Volkswagen Golf GTI
vehicles.excerpt: Eighth-generation Golf GTI with the six-speed manual gearbox, 180 kW and the classic tartan sport seats.
description: This Golf GTI combines the 2.0 TSI engine with 180 kW and the six-speed manual gearbox, a combination that is increasingly hard to find. It is an everyday hatchback with a lively, engaging drive.
The GTI sport seats in Scalepaper tartan, the digital cockpit, navigation, adaptive cruise control and wireless charging are fitted.
First registered in March 2022 with 63,500 km. Sold under the margin scheme with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty.

vehicles.title: Tesla Model Y Long Range
vehicles.excerpt: Model Y Long Range AWD with 533 km WLTP range, heat pump and tow bar. A spacious electric family SUV.
description: The Model Y Long Range combines dual-motor all-wheel drive with a WLTP range of 533 km and access to fast charging. It is a practical electric family SUV with a large boot and a front luggage compartment.

A heat pump, panoramic glass roof, heated seats and a tow bar are fitted. Navigation and driver assistance run through Tesla’s own central touchscreen; Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are not supported.
First registered in June 2024 with 35,800 km. Supplied with Car-Pass and a 12-month dealer warranty. VAT is deductible.
